description: Scan a domain for AI discoverability. Use when evaluating AI crawler access; NOT when assessing general web crawler policies, use crawler_policy_guide.
name: check_ai_readiness

ai_crawler_access.description: Access permissions for various AI crawlers.

ClaudeBot.description: Access status for ClaudeBot (allowed, disallowed, or unknown).

GPTBot.description: Access status for GPTBot (allowed, disallowed, or unknown).

OAI-SearchBot.description: Access status for OAI-SearchBot (allowed, disallowed, or unknown).

PerplexityBot.description: Access status for PerplexityBot (allowed, disallowed, or unknown).

content_signals.description: Content signals detected on the homepage.

heading_structure.description: The structure of headings (H1, H2, etc.) on the homepage.

image_alt_text.description: Alt text for images on the homepage.

word_count.description: The number of words on the homepage.

domain.description: The domain or URL that was scanned.

llms_txt_presence.description: Indicates whether an llms.txt file is present.

meta_tags.description: Meta tags found on the homepage.

content.description: The content of the meta tag.

name.description: The name of the meta tag.

schema_org_data.description: Schema.org structured data found on the homepage.

sitemap_presence.description: Indicates whether a sitemap.xml file is present.

title: Check AI readiness
